observations: Photo 0: Silver-and-black retro-style mirrorless body with 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' engraved on top plate; front body cap (Nikon Z mount) is on, no lens visible.
Photo 1: Same camera now shown with a manual-focus lens attached; aperture/distance scale rings show markings in feet/meters and f-stops, ISO dial on top shows 100-51200 range and 'Z fc' text.

Photo 2: Top-down flat-lay showing camera body with lens mounted, a battery labeled 'Nikon Rechargeable Li-ion Battery', a Nikon-branded charger, two rear lens caps, and a cap marked 'TTArtisan APS-C 35mm F2.0'.
No photo shows the rear LCD/EVF screen powered on, no sample image, no shutter-count screen, no SD card slot or ports.
The lens mounted appears to be a third-party TTArtisan 35mm f/2.0 manual lens, not a Nikon lens, based on the cap in photo 2.

claims.claim: Nikon Z fc is a retro-inspired, SLR-style mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' engraved on the body
No sensor spec plate, menu screen, or EXIF data visible in any photo

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have electronic faults
risks.proof: Video clip of camera powering on, showing rear screen live view and a test shot

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, sensor may show excess wear
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from menu or a dedicated counter app

risks.risk: LCD/EVF condition unknown (cracks, dead pixels, flicker)
risks.proof: Clear photo or video of screen and viewfinder turned on

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or fungus not visible with cap on
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sensor with lens removed, and a sample photo against plain sky
Photo of battery info screen or charger cycle readout

risks.risk: Bundled lens is third-party manual-focus (TTArtisan), not a Nikon lens, affecting value expectations
risks.proof: Already visible in photo 2 cap text; no further proof needed, but confirm no Nikon kit lens included
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + manual third-party lens only, no Nikon lens included

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on with a live view and a test shutter actuation
Screenshot of shutter count from camera menu
Close-up of sensor with lens detached
Photo of rear screen and EVF turned on
Confirmation/photo of any additional Nikon-branded lens if included
response.reason: The camera body is clearly identified as a Nikon Z fc from engraved markings in two photos, and the included accessories (battery, charger, third-party TTArtisan lens) are visible, but functionality, shutter count, and screen/sensor condition are unproven, so it must be priced at worst case as non-tested/working-unconfirmed until further proof is given.
